body:
SPEC DRAFT DECISION REQUEST — the off-tree markup/envelope draft is now implementation-shaped at
about 4,800 words. No repository path has been edited.

Three proposed decisions need explicit chief/ADR disposition before code:

1. DEPENDENCY-SAFE OWNERSHIP. acquire owns SourceIdentities, TargetUniverse, stage/semantic
   outcomes, and AcquisitionAccount. view owns projection/report outcomes, provenance-derived
   ViewBasis, and the composed StoryOutputResult. codec intentionally adds the currently acyclic
   codec -> view edge and owns StoryOutputResultCodec plus BundleManifestCodec. StoryAtlas owns
   emitted bytes/files and browser lowering. This avoids both erased JSON and a new module.

2. CANONICAL TEXT MUST SURVIVE REPORT FAILURE. The earlier six-path sketch loses the canonical
   coordinate string when semantics are partial/refused and HTML lowering also fails; only its hash
   remains, so standoff evidence cannot be interpreted. I propose a seventh conditional core role,
   canonical.txt / canonical_source: exact UTF-8 StorySource.canonicalText, no BOM or added newline,
   emitted whenever canonicalization succeeds. It carries coordinates, not semantic authority.
   source.txt remains byte-for-byte original input. Policy id storysource-canonical-text/v1 binds
   the current CR/LF, trailing-space, blank-run, and edge-blank transformation exactly.

3. TWO VERSIONED WIRE ROOTS. result.json uses story-output-result/v1 and separates acquisition,
   view basis, projection outcomes, report requests, and report outcomes. manifest.json uses
   story-output-manifest/v1, omits a self-checksum, and checksums every other promised role with the
   existing SHA-256 Checksum. Core role/status tags are closed enums; extensions require namespace,
   schema id, checksum, and a registered codec. Unknown extensions fail closed.

The draft also specifies Established versus Unestablished constructor laws, exactly-once member
and requested-report accounting, provenance-derived basis, partial delivery, portable relative
paths, canonical JSON bytes, first-view failure semantics, separate discourse/world-time/causal
geometry, textual/graphical equivalence, accessibility, determinism, and 15 mutation-capable
acceptance courts.

Chief: please cut the spec child bead at docs/design/story-output-bundle-spec.md with its exact gate,
and rule on the three decisions above plus the owner-directed implementation staffing amendment.
I will preserve the provider reservation on build.sbt and will not enter the new-engineer or
StoryAtlas owners paths without reassignment.
